searchText: > How about a vote 😄 > > 1️⃣ `GASPREMIUM` > 2️⃣ `MINER_PREMIUM` > 3️⃣ `MINER_INCENTIVE` > 4️⃣ `MINER_TIP` > 5️⃣ `MINER_FEE` > 6️⃣ `MINER_PAYMENT` > 7️⃣ `INCLUSION_FEE` > 8️⃣ `MINER_REWARD` Given that we haven't solved the "meta naming" conversation, does anyone object renaming the bribe to `MINER FEE` for now? I've gotten more negative feedback about bribe and am eager to just update the spec for clarity. This will also have all three terms using "fee". If we want to find a naming scheme that uses "price", we can do that later. Made a visual version I think is quite cohesive. Could change to Gas Price <@!187490121698770945> This is great! One small thing: could you maybe change "Protocol Fee" to "Base Fee" (to match current terms)? Sure Also, maybe we should have another box wrapping everything for "Fee cap" (The maximum you are willing to pay for a transaction) Like this? Yes, perfect 😄 ! Asked for feedback on Twitter. Let's see if it makes sense to a broader audience. 😅 I no longer desire "Miner Bribe", but for the same reason I also do not like "Miner Fee". I'm quite concerned that when users see "fee" they will think that it represents an amount, but really it is one component of a fee and by itself is pretty meaningless to end users. If we switch `Fee` in all three places to `Price`, then I'm fine with the proposed terms otherwise. `Gas Price, Base Price, Miner Price` Here's a proposal by <@!550420431744794624>: https://twitter.com/CarlBeek/status/1328377571780812803 `base price`, `price cap`, `inclusion incentive`. The last term is Eth2-compatible, which is nice. I'm a bit against `gas price` because it is still used for legacy transactions, so it will cause confusion to have two things with the same name. I think we can colloquially use `gas price` to refer to the sum of `base price` + `price cap` (e.g. how much did the user end up paying for the transaction), but as part of the spec I'd rather have distinct terms which can have clear definitions. Relatedly, does anyone think it would be valuable to have a "Definitions" section in the EIP itself 🤔 ? Definitions section in the EIP is a great idea Between Price and Fee, only the term Miner Price seems weird too me. The rest seems fine Inclusion incentive seems pretty obtuse and although accurate I am not sure people will know what it means without a lot of clarification around deeper context. https://twitter.com/TarasBob/status/1328432705294327808?s=20 Changing to price seems like a good call, as I needed to talk about it as a price to clarify here. What is the parent term we talk about that includes both Miners and Staking nodes? block producers? Is that right? How about miner premium? Only works for Eth1, but it's pretty clear. We can change variable names when we migrate to Eth2 🙂 So base price, miner premium, price cap

excerpts.author: timbeiko
excerpts.content:
> How about a vote 😄 
> 
> 1️⃣  `GASPREMIUM`
> 2️⃣  `MINER_PREMIUM`
> 3️⃣ `MINER_INCENTIVE`
> 4️⃣  `MINER_TIP`
> 5️⃣  `MINER_FEE`
> 6️⃣ `MINER_PAYMENT`
> 7️⃣ `INCLUSION_FEE`
> 8️⃣ `MINER_REWARD`

Given that we haven't solved the "meta naming" conversation, does anyone object renaming the bribe to `MINER FEE` for now? I've gotten more negative feedback about bribe and am eager to just update the spec for clarity. This will also have all three terms using "fee". If we want to find a naming scheme that uses "price", we can do that later.
